Class TypefaceLayout

java.lang.Object
net.phoenix.chromatic_codes.client.typeface.TypefaceLayout
public final class TypefaceLayout extends Object
A line's shaped glyphs and their source boundaries, independent of both GPU backends.

      public String trim(int width, boolean reverse, boolean bidi)
      Finds a logical substring without cutting a shaped cluster or formatting code.

      width - maximum GUI width

    • split

      public int split(int width, boolean bidi)
      Finds the next wrap boundary, preferring a previous space and making progress even at zero width.
      Parameters:
      width - maximum line width in GUI units
      bidi - language direction for checking reshaped lines
      Returns:
      offset of the next line boundary in the original string

      Returns:
